facts.business: Noida Toll Bridge Company Limited operates the DND Flyway, an 8-lane, 7.5 km access-controlled expressway across the Yamuna River connecting Noida to South Delhi, along with a 1.7 km Mayur Vihar link, on a Build-Own-Operate-Transfer (BOOT) basis.

auditor.name: Kumar Wadhwa & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Board of Directors not duly constituted; Company under investigation by Central Government under Section 242 of Companies Act, 2013 pertaining to IL&FS group

key_risks: Going concern and resolution process: Classified as 'Red' entity under IL&FS Resolution Framework, debt unserviced since Oct 15, 2018
Revenue concentration: User fee collection permanently discontinued; revenues concentrated in advertisement and licence income; NOIDA sought to stop advertisement displays and recover >Rs 100 crore
Income tax matters: Residual uncertainty from remanded matters and potential appeals by Revenue; historical demands of Rs 1,340.03 crore and Rs 10,893.30 crore
Contractual claims: Arbitration claims against NOIDA stayed by Supreme Court; timing and outcome uncertain
